title: Cartwise+ Membership Pause Booking and the Longest Available Pause
content:
A Cartwise+ Membership pause starts on the next renewal date and, when the member asks for the longest pause available, runs for the pause allowance, which may be longer than the plan's longest pause in the plan's pause terms. The booked length is recorded on the membership and in its pause history.

The pause length for a member who asked for a pause while on Cartwise+ Annual is not fixed until the membership shows Cartwise+ Monthly as its plan, with a plan-switch charge captured on the day its current period began.

Stated as a record check: while the membership record shows Cartwise+ Annual as the plan, or shows no plan-switch charge captured on the first day of its current period, the pause length of a member who asked while on Cartwise+ Annual is not yet fixed.

## What the booking does

| Item | Position |
|---|---|
| First paused day | the next renewal date — the date the current paid period ends |
| Length | the booked number of calendar days, the renewal date counted as the first paused day |
| Recorded | the first and last paused days on the membership, and one new entry in its pause history with the booked length |
| While paused | no fee is charged and no order benefit applies |

## Invocation: `book_membership_pause_b6aef13b`

This is an agent-side action: the agent unlocks `book_membership_pause_b6aef13b` and calls it. One call pauses the membership starting on its next renewal date for the given number of calendar days, records the first and last paused days, sets the membership to paused, and adds one entry to its pause history with the booked length.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `membership_id` | the reference number of the Cartwise+ membership being paused, read from the membership lookup | identifier |
| `pause_days` | the booked length of the pause in calendar days | an integer of at least 1 |

**Return.** On success the tool returns a receipt with `pause_entry_id` (the new pause-history entry's reference number), `membership_id`, `pause_start_date` (the first paused day), `pause_end_date` (the last paused day), `pause_days` (as booked) and `status` of `paused`, meaning the pause now stands on the membership. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. The tool defines no error return.

## Hypothetical illustration of the dates

A membership whose current period ends on 20 July, booked for 30 days: the first paused day is 20 July and the last paused day is 18 August (20 July plus 29 days).
